messages:
alice (Marketing): Quick sync  we need a crisp one-pager + a 2-page solution brief for enterprise buyers choosing secure deployment modes (VPC, on-prem, GovCloud). Primary uses: webinar follow-up, AE handoff, and inbound routing. Can we get a draft by Tue?
sam (FieldSales): For routing, propose ARR >= $300k -> AE immediate. ARR 100k-300k -> AM + SE. <100k -> PLG nurture. Add "compliance=high" tag to force AE triage regardless of ARR.
rita (Eng): I'll give a short tech blurb and a tiny config snippet. Suggested SLA line: `SLA: 99.9% monthly availability`. Latency note: `p95 < 180ms on Dedicated (typical)`. Fallback behavior: automatic routing to hosted or compatible quantized variants during capacity events.
oliver (Security): Security checklist to highlight: SOC2 Type II, ISO27001, support for customer-managed keys (AWS KMS, Azure KV, HSM), audit logging + S3 export. Callout: "Legal intake available for BAA/DPA."
alice (Marketing): Messaging hierarchy idea: 1) Isolation & control 2) Predictable performance & SLAs 3) Cost controls + Optimize toolkit. One-pager must be skimmable (bullets). Two-pager can include routing playbook table and anonymized benchmark numbers.
sam (FieldSales): For the playbook include example HubSpot mapping and an automated task: when tag=gov -> create AE task + set priority. Also include sample subject line for AE outreach: "Redwood: compliance trial & performance review".
rita (Eng): Benchmark blurb: "Example customer on Dedicated saw ~50-65% token-cost reduction with prefix caching + 2x throughput from batching." I'll attach an anonymized graph for p95 vs batch size.
oliver (Security): Add short deployment options bullet: VPC peering (managed control plane), customer-managed control plane in VPC, or fully air-gapped on-prem. Note supported ports: 443 and optional 9090 for metrics.
alice (Marketing): I'll draft CTAs: AE CTA (30s): "Book a tailored trial for SLA-backed capacity, private networking, and a compliance review with our solutions engineers." PLG CTA (15s): "Start a free Redwood trial and upgrade when you need SLAs or private deployment."
content-bot: document uploaded by alice: enterprise-deployments-brief-draft-v1.pdf -> https://drive.redwood.com/drive/xyz123
alice (Marketing): Review owners: Sam (routing/GTM), Rita (tech accuracy), Oliver (security/legal). Please comment by Mon EOD so we can publish after the webinar. Thanks everyone :rocket:
